Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Lon Clark is credited on 27 distinct recordings across 8 programs from 1943-07-10 through 1974-11-06. Documented roles include performer on 27 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Theater Five (performer on 6 recordings; 6 distinct recordings), Words at War (performer on 6 recordings; 6 distinct recordings), 2000 Plus (performer on 5 recordings; 5 distinct recordings), Quiet Please (performer on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), CBS Radio Mystery Theater (performer on 3 recordings; 3 distinct recordings), The Adventures of the Abbotts (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Mysterious Traveler (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and The Weird Circle (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).
